blocks.title: About this project
blocks.description: A learning exercise for Nuxt 4, Nuxt UI, and file-based content.

blocks.body:
This site pulls from two places. Pages like this one are JSON files under content/, served through a Nitro route. Articles come from DummyJSON, a public demo API, proxied through the same server so the frontend never talks to it directly.

Two ideas are on purpose: fetching is always useFetch against /api/*, never a direct import of content into a component, and this page itself is not a hardcoded route. It exists because content/pages/about.json exists; delete the file and the page is gone, add a new one and a new page appears at that slug, resolved by a single catch-all route.
